high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Times of India" website. The headline reads: "41 Russian aircraft targeted in Operation 'Spider's Web'". The article discusses Ukraine's claims regarding the destruction of Russian aircraft during a coordinated drone attack. It mentions that Ukraine has claimed significant damage was inflicted on 41 Russian aircraft, with an independent verification yet to be conducted. The country also claims to have destroyed 34% of Russia's strategic bombers carrying cruise missiles, estimating damages at $7 billion.
